title: How Many Directions Must a Truncated Diffusion Sampler Retain? Matching Bounds Under Power-Law Spectra
summary: Diffusion samplers can reduce computation by generating selected spectral coordinates and filling the remaining directions with noise. How many directions must they retain? We study this question for data with power-law covariance spectra. For Gaussian data compared to a smoothed target, we prove matching bounds on the required number of retained directions, provided that the ambient dimension is sufficiently large.
